supports.description: Path, query and header parameters with their schemas and required flags.
JSON request and response bodies with declared media types.
Success, accepted and error responses with status codes.
Security schemes (http bearer and basic, apiKey, oauth2 client-credentials and authorization-code, OpenID Connect, mutual TLS) and per-operation security requirements.
Accepted (202) responses distinct from the eventual result, with the status operation.

unsupported.reason: Multipart and form bodies are not represented.
Callbacks and webhooks are not represented.
A decimal travels as a string so no digit is lost to binary floating point; JSON Schema bounds such a value only by sign, precision and scale, not by an arbitrary minimum or maximum.
A pinned external schema is referenced, not inlined.

tooling.purpose: Validates the document against the OpenAPI specification.
Detects breaking changes against the accepted baseline's document.

proofLimits: Specification validity does not establish that a running service conforms.
oasdiff classifies document differences; ownership, behavioral and policy consequences come from the model comparison.

checks.claim: The generated OpenAPI document validates against the OpenAPI 3.1 specification, every templated path declares its path parameters and every operation id is unique.
oasdiff reports no breaking change between the accepted baseline's document and the candidate's that the model comparison did not also report.
checks.limits: Document-level compatibility only; consumer behavior is not exercised.
